about: Filing under labels. On 27 Oct 2026 the sales@ mailbox had two labels: 'GCW dispute' (All emails regarding GC Wind Services) and 'New Solar Products'. Postie put 8 threads under GCW dispute; 4 did not belong. Cause: an email that looked legal or formal with no fitting label was given the nearest one instead of none. A sixth case checks the topic label still works. Each case lists the labels on offer and the answer Postie must give.

labels.name: GCW dispute
labels.description: All emails regarding GC Wind Services

labels.name: New Solar Products
labels.description: Emails from suppliers showing new products that might interest us, brands we use

input.subject: Thomson Energy Solutions Pty Limited (Subject to Restructuring Plan) & Anor ats GC Wind Services Pty Ltd - Supreme Court of NSW proceeding
input.body_gist: Court correspondence in the GC Wind Services matter, orders and dates.

cases.why: The sender and subject name GC Wind Services: the label's description matches word for word.

input.from: case manager at the workers compensation insurer
input.subject: Fwd: Subsequent Case Conference Summary Email - Mr [staff member] - [claim number]
input.body_gist: Summary of a case conference about an injured staff member's return to work plan.

cases.why: Formal and legal-looking, but nothing to do with GC Wind Services. No label fits, so none. A new label for the staff member's claim is private HR and not for the shared inbox's label list.

input.from: case manager at the workers compensation insurer
input.subject: Fwd: Mr [staff member] [claim number] - RTW Plan Submission
input.body_gist: Return to work plan submitted for the injured staff member.

cases.why: Same matter as the case conference email, same answer: no label.

input.subject: [Sigenergy] Re: Action Required - Outstanding Recall Cases Transferred to CSP
input.body_gist: A manufacturer moving open recall cases to a service partner, asks for action on outstanding units.

cases.why: A product recall from a supplier is not a dispute with GC Wind Services and not a new product. No label; it needs a person (installed units may be affected) so it stays Priority.

input.subject: panel clean photo
input.body_gist: A photo of cleaned solar panels, one line of text.

cases.why: A customer photo. No label fits and nothing legal about it; if the customer has a job it should be tagged to the job, never to a dispute label.

input.from: account manager at a solar wholesaler we buy from
input.subject: Now available: Fronius GEN24 Plus 10kW, stock arriving next week
input.body_gist: A supplier presenting a new inverter model they now stock, with datasheet attached and pricing on request.

cases.why: A topic label: a supplier presenting a product it sells, from a brand we use. The label's description matches, so it is applied.
